parts.name: Root
parts.description: The textarea control. Renders a native <textarea> and forwards all native attributes while exposing state through data attributes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Removes the textarea from interaction and focus order.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the textarea focusable while preventing edits. Maps to `readonly` and `aria-readonly`.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the textarea as invalid. Maps to `aria-invalid` and `data-invalid`.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the textarea as required. Maps to `required` and `aria-required`.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered textarea element.

props.name: autoResize
props.description: Grows the textarea height with its content.

props.name: minRows
props.description: Minimum number of visible rows while auto-resizing.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Maximum number of visible rows while auto-resizing.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the textarea is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the textarea has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-hovered
dataAttributes.description: Present while the pointer is over the textarea.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the textarea is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the textarea is readonly.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the textarea is required.
